description:
SuperBooks is bookkeeping for freelancers and small teams: bank transactions with AI categorisation, invoices, customers, a receipt inbox and document vault, a time tracker, and financial reports. The SuperBooks plugin lets ChatGPT work your books from your own account: list and inspect transactions, fix a category or workflow status, find unpaid or overdue invoices, draft a new invoice for a customer (drafts are never sent until you say so), look up customers and add new ones, search receipts and documents, match a receipt to a transaction, start and stop time tracking, and pull profit & loss, burn rate, runway, spending by category, revenue, balances, top customers and recurring expenses.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; you approve read and write scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered. Destructive operations — deleting transactions, customers, categories, tags, documents or inbox items, and voiding invoices — are hidden behind a team-level "Destructive AI tools" switch that is OFF by default, on top of the credential's own scope. Every credential is rate-limited (120 calls a minute) and can be revoked at any time from Settings → Developer.

The plugin never moves money: bank connections, payments and billing are only reachable in the app. Sending an invoice e-mails it to your customer, and nothing else leaves your account. No purchases are made in-tool, no images, video or audio are generated, and no ads are served.

positive.description: Profit and loss over a range
positive.prompt: Show me profit and loss for June through September 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Four monthly rows (2026-06 to 2026-09) each with revenue, expense and delta, plus totals — roughly $14.9k revenue against $7.8k expense — in USD. All figures come from the seeded bank transactions, so nothing is zero.

positive.prompt: List my unpaid invoices, then show me the first one in detail.
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools, then execute_typescript calling external_invoices_list and external_invoices_get
positive.expected_behavior: Three unpaid invoices (INV-0001, INV-0002, INV-0003) with amount, currency, issue and due dates; INV-0001 is already past due. The detail call returns the customer, line items, note and sent_at timestamp.

positive.description: Draft an invoice for an existing customer
positive.prompt: Create a draft invoice for Cedar Valley Books: 6 hours of design at $125, due in 30 days.
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools, then execute_typescript calling external_customers_list and external_invoices_create_draft
positive.expected_behavior: The customer is looked up by name, then a new invoice number (INV-000N) with status draft is returned. The draft is visible under Invoices in the app and is NOT sent — the customer receives nothing until invoices_send is called explicitly.

positive.prompt: Find the September Figma transaction and file it under Design Software.
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools, then execute_typescript calling external_transactions_list, external_categories_list and external_transactions_update_category
positive.expected_behavior: The Figma Professional transaction from 2026-09-01 is found, the design_software slug is confirmed from the category list, and the update returns the transaction with the new category. Listing again shows the change persisted.

positive.prompt: How much time have I logged on the Harbor & Pine project in September?
positive.tools_triggered: search_tools, then execute_typescript calling external_tracker_list_projects and external_tracker_list_entries
positive.expected_behavior: The project 'Harbor & Pine website redesign' (customer Harbor & Pine Architecture, 80 hour estimate, in progress) is found, then its three September entries — kickoff interviews, sitemap and wireframes, visual design exploration — with start and stop times totalling 9 hours 45 minutes.

negative.description: Bulk delete with the destructive switch off
negative.prompt: Delete all my transactions from June.

negative.description: Paying a bill or moving money
negative.prompt: Pay the Figma invoice from my Studio Checking account.
Connect my Chase account so transactions sync automatically.

publication.release_notes: Logo refresh: the listing icons are replaced with the official 1024px brand logo. No change to the MCP server, tools, OAuth or test account.
